svg.title: AI Automation for Video Creation
svg.desc: Seven-stage filmstrip timeline workflow for video creation automation: raw clips upload via webhook, ElevenLabs API transcribes speech with moving waveform and typing captions, best moments highlight on the filmstrip, Runway and HeyGen assemble cuts via API, captions and 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 sizes pop out, a human reviews, and finished videos land in the scheduler queue.
